properties.description: Built 2026-10-20 (reasoning.rs). A contested Decision governing the steps that conclude a claim is walked with the claim and set on its contested_by_design; GOVERNED_BY `ruling: held` (structure.yaml) marks the side the Decision holds: each support step reads `as_reading` held or rival, and the dispute's `held_reading` names it; read on a Decision, reasoning_report lists its `positions`, each with truth, proof status, what it rests on, assumptions and lines. On the cogito, "I exist" now lists dec:which-reading-of-the-cogito (was []).
properties.name: A dispute kept open is read from the claim its rival readings conclude and from the question, with the owner's held reading marked
